intent: DC-01 envelope-encryption: AesGcmPayloadCipher.encrypt(...) / decrypt(...) is the plan's own adapter at the store boundary, protecting raw record and revision payloads at rest; the key is read through the named spring.ssl.bundle.pem bundle, never a literal. SI-11 external-key-store: the key stays outside the data store, resolved from ${ENV} or a mounted path.

methods.semantics: ciphertext must not be null; tampering is refused
